lessons.title: Playwright na enna?
lessons.story: Oru chinna robot friend-a imagine pannunga. Avan oru web browser-a open pannitu, neenga pannura maadhiri type pannuvaan, click pannuvaan, scroll pannuvaan. Neenga oru to-do list ezhudhunga, robot adhai follow pannitu, edhavadhu thappa irundha solliduvaan. Andha robot dhaan `Playwright`. Idhu Microsoft senjadhu; Chrome, Firefox, Safari (WebKit) moonulayum work aagum.
lessons.codeCaption: Same story dhaan, words mattum puthusu: browser-a launch pannu, oru tab (`page`) open pannu, site-ku po, close pannu.
points: `chromedriver.exe` download panna venaam, browser version-oda match panna venaam. Playwright thanoda browsers-a thaane kondu varum.
Idhu Node.js-la odum. Neenga TypeScript-la ezhudhuveenga; adhu types irukura JavaScript (Java maadhiri dhaan!).
Chromium, Firefox, WebKit ellathukum ore API.

quiz.question: Playwright-la neengale manage panna vendiyadhillaadhadhu edhu?
quiz.why: Playwright thanoda browsers-a thaane download panni manage pannum, so driver thollai illa.

deep.text: Selenium oru thani driver program-oda (chromedriver) HTTP vazhiya pesum; andha driver browser-oda pesum. Playwright naduvula irukkuravara skip pannitu, browser-oda oru fast connection-a open-a vechchu, adhu vazhiya commands anuppudhu. Adhunaala dhaan idhu fast; network calls, page load maadhiri vishayangalaiyum gavanikka mudiyudhu.

`Browser` nu sonna muzhu browser program. `BrowserContext` adhukulla irukkura clean profile (incognito window maadhiri: thani cookies, thani storage). `Page` nu sonna oru context-kulla irukkura oru tab. `Locator` nu sonna page-la irukkura oru vishayatha point pannura pointer.

deep.title: Browser → Context → Page
deep.code:
const browser = await chromium.launch();          // the browser program
const context = await browser.newContext();       // a clean profile
const page = await context.newPage();             // a tab
const other = await browser.newContext();         // totally separate user

deep.text: `@playwright/test` use pannumbodhu, ovvoru test-ukkum browser, context, page-a adhuve create pannidum. Scripts-la mattum dhaan neenga kaiyaala pannuveenga.
Playwright, Selenium-oda compatible illa. Unga Java `WebDriver` code-a thirumba use panna mudiyaadhu; aana ideas (locators, waits, page objects) ellaam appadiye varum.

challenge.prompt: Oru chinna script ezhudhunga (test illa): playwright.dev-a open pannitu, page title-a console-la print pannitu, browser-a close pannunga.

moreQuiz.question: BrowserContext edhu maadhiri?
moreQuiz.why: Oru context-ukku thani cookies, storage irukku; mathha contexts-la irundhu pirichchu irukkum.

moreQuiz.question: Oru BrowserContext-la ethanai Pages irukkalaam?
moreQuiz.why: Oru context pala tabs-a (pages) vechchirukkalaam.

lessons.title: Selenium-a vida yen ellarukkum pidikkudhu?
lessons.story: Selenium-la, oru door munnadi nindhu "Open aayiducha? Open aayiducha?" nu thirumba thirumba kekkuveenga (adhu dhaan `WebDriverWait`). Playwright-la robot porumaiya irukkum. Door open aagura varaikkum thaane wait pannitu, appuram ulla pogum. Kelvi kammi; silly reasons-ku fail aagura tests-um kammi.
lessons.javaCode:
WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
wait.until(ExpectedConditions.elementToBeClickable(By.id("login"))).click();
lessons.code:
// Playwright waits for the button automatically
await page.locator('#login').click();
lessons.codeCaption: Selenium-la rendu line wait code, inga zero.
points: Auto-waiting: click panradhukku munnadi element therigiradha, enabled-a, asaiyama irukkaa nu thaane check pannum.
Tests default-ave parallel-a odum; romba fast.
Ulle ye irukku: reports, screenshots, videos, trace viewer, API testing, network mocking.
Ovvoru test-kum thani, clean browser context (puthu incognito window maadhiri).

quiz.question: Button 2 second late-a varudhu. `click()` enna pannum?
quiz.why: Auto-wait dhaan super power: element ready aagura varaikkum (timeout varai) click() wait pannum.

deep.text: Code maatram illama oru test sila neram pass, sila neram fail aanaa adhu flaky. Pothuvaana kaaranam: test, page-a vida fast-a odudhu. Button ready aagum munnaadiye click pannudhu, illana text varuvadharku munnaadi padikkudhu. Playwright-oda auto-wait, retry panra assertions idhula perumbaalaanadhai design-laye sari pannidum.

Ovvoru Playwright test-um adhuvukkunnu thani fresh context-la odum. Test A-la login pannadhu test B-a paadhikkaadhu. Selenium-la cookies clear panna illana driver-a restart panna neenga gnabagam vechchukkanum.

deep.title: 4 workers-la 100 tests-a parallel-a odudhal
deep.code: npx playwright test --workers=4

deep.text: Contexts romba cheap (milliseconds) and workers thani processes-nu irukkradhunaala, Selenium-la oru manineram eduththa suites perumbaalum sila nimishathula mudiyum.
Playwright magic illa. Mosamaana locators, share panna test data, vittu pona `await` ippovum flaky tests-a create pannum. Ovvoru onnaiyum eppadi thavirkkardhunu kathukkalaam.

challenge.prompt: Unga sontha Selenium suite-a paarunga. Explicit wait illa Thread.sleep use panna 3 idangalai ezhudhunga. Ovvonnaiyum edhu Playwright feature remove pannum? (auto-wait, web-first assertion, waitForURL pathi yosinga.)

moreQuiz.question: Playwright tests yen onnukkonnu isolate aagi irukku?
options: Ovvoru test-ukkum fresh browser context kidaikkum
moreQuiz.why: Ovvoru test-ukkum puthu context irundha cookies illa state leak aagaadhu.

moreQuiz.question: Flaky tests-oda pothuvaana kaaranam edhu?
options: Page ready aagum munnaadi act pannuradhu
moreQuiz.why: Page-a vida fast-a irukkuradhu dhaan classic kaaranam.

lessons.title: Unga first test
lessons.story: Robot-kitta solvom: "Playwright website-ku poi, page title-la Playwright nu irukkaa paaru." Adhu dhaan oru test! Test-ku oru peyar kudukkureenga, free-a oru `page` (puthu browser tab) kedaikkum, appuram steps ezhudhureenga.
lessons.codeCaption: Run panna: npx playwright test
points: `test('name', ...)` dhaan unga `@Test`.
`{ page }` na: "Playwright, oru puthu tab kudu." Driver setup code venaam.
`/Playwright/` oru regular expression; "Playwright irukku" nu artham.
`await` engayum varum. Yen nu TypeScript section-la paapom.

quiz.question: Test-la `page` na enna?
quiz.why: Ovvoru test-kum Playwright clean tab create panni ulla kudukkum.

deep.text: Ovvoru test-um same shape dhaan: Arrange (engayaavadhu po), Act (click, type), Assert (check pannu). Oru test-ukku oru main idea mattum vachchukkonga.

deep.text: Terminal-la pass/fail theriyum. HTML report `playwright-report/`-la ezhudhappadum. Configure pannirundha, failures-oda screenshots, traces `test-results/`-la save aagum.
`npx playwright test --ui` use panni indha test-a time-travel timeline-oda odi paarunga. Kathukka idhu dhaan best vazhi.
Oru file-la test names unique-a irukkanum. 'test1' illa, 'user can sign in' maadhiri behaviour-a describe pannunga.

lessons.title: Java friends-ku Node and npm
lessons.story: Java-la JDK, Maven, `pom.xml` irundhudhu. Inga `Node` engine (JVM maadhiri), `npm` package manager (Maven maadhiri), `package.json` shopping list. `npx` na oru program-a permanent-a install pannaama unga list-la irundhu run panra handy tool.
lessons.javaCode:
mvn clean test
mvn dependency:tree
lessons.code:
npm install                 # install everything in package.json (mvn install)
npm install -D dotenv       # add a dev-only dependency (<scope>test</scope>)
npm run test:smoke          # run a script from package.json
npx playwright test         # run a locally installed tool
npm ls --depth=0            # list direct dependencies
lessons.codeCaption: `-D` na dev dependency: development-kum tests-kum venum; ship panna illa.
points: `dependencies` ship panna; `devDependencies` Playwright maadhiri testing tools-ku.
`package-lock.json` exact versions-a lock pannum. Adhai commit pannunga; CI-la `npm ci` use pannunga.
`node_modules`-a eppo venumnaalum delete pannitu `npm install` vachi thirumba create pannalaam.

quiz.question: CI-la lock file-la irukkuradhai appadiye install panra command edhu?
quiz.why: `npm ci` clean, reproducible install.

deep.title: package.json

deep.text: Scripts nu sonna shortcuts: `npm test` na `playwright test` odum; mathha scripts-ukku `npm run name` use pannunga. Neenda commands-a oru edathula vaikka teams scripts use pannum.

TypeScript evlo strict-a irukkanum-nu solludhu. Playwright TypeScript-a neradiyaa odurathunaala (kaiyaala compile pannanum-nu illa), idhai rombavum maathamaattenga. JSON imports-ukku `resolveJsonModule`-a enable pannalaam.
`npx playwright --version` edhu install aagi irukku-nu kaattum. Maasam illa rendu maasathukku oru thadava update pannunga: ovvoru release-um puthu browsers, features kondu varum.
Project velaikku packages-a global-a (`npm i -g`) install pannaadheenga. Team-la ellaarukkum same version irukka, tools-a project-kulla vainga.

challenge.prompt: Chromium project-a headed-a mattum odura `test:chrome` nu oru script serthu, adhai eppadi run pannanum nu kaattunga.

moreQuiz.question: `^1.50.0` edhai allow pannudhu?
moreQuiz.why: Caret minor and patch updates-a allow pannum.

lessons.title: Variables and types
lessons.story: Variables na peyar ottina boxes. `const` box glue pottu ottiyaachu: ulla vachadhu maaraadhu. `let` box-a open panni appuram maathalaam. Type-a colon-ku appuram ezhudhuveenga, name tag maadhiri: `age: number`.
lessons.codeCaption: TypeScript pala time type-a guess pannidum, so `const x = 5` nu kooda ezhudhalaam.
points: Default-a `const` use pannunga; value maarina mattum `let`. `var` venaam.
Numbers-ku ore type: `number` (int, double, long illa).
Compare panna `===` use pannunga, `==` venaam.
Semicolon optional; aana neraiya perr podhuvaanga.

quiz.question: Aprom value-a maatha allow panra keyword edhu?
quiz.why: `let` boxes-a maathalaam; `const` mudiyaadhu.

deep.text: Oru variable pala types-la onnaa irukkalaam. `|` (pipe) use pannunga. 'Value illa onnum illa'nu solradhukku idhu romba common.

deep.title: Unions
deep.code:
let id: string | number = 'abc';
id = 123;                      // also fine

let nickname: string | undefined;   // may be missing
let status: 'pass' | 'fail' = 'pass'; // only these two words

deep.title: Strict-a irunga

deep.text: TypeScript-a infer panna vidunga. `const url = 'https://x.com'` already `string`. Function parameters-ukkum, compiler guess panna mudiyaadha edathukkum mattum types add pannunga.
`const` objects-a freeze pannaadhu: `const user = {}; user.name = 'x'` work aagum. Variable-a vera onnukku point pannuradhai mattum thadukkum.

challenge.prompt: Declare pannunga: const `baseUrl` (string), 2-la aarambikkura let `retries` (number), 'chromium' and 'firefox' irukkura const `browsers` array. Appuram template string vachi oru sentence print pannunga.

moreQuiz.question: Edhu comparison-a prefer pannanum?
moreQuiz.why: `===` ungalukku theriyaama types-a maathaadhu.

moreQuiz.question: `string | undefined` na enna?
moreQuiz.why: Value illaamayum irukkalaam.

lessons.title: Functions and arrow functions
lessons.story: Function na recipe card: ingredients kudutha, dish tharum. Arrow function adhe recipe-a `=>` vachu short-a ezhudhuradhu. Playwright full-a arrows varum, because tests-um arrow functions dhaan.
lessons.codeCaption: `(x) => ...` na Java-oda lambda `x -> ...` maadhiri dhaan.
points: Java lambda `x -> x + 1` dhaan TypeScript-la `(x) => x + 1`.
Return type bracket-ku appuram: `): number`.
`console.log()` dhaan unga `System.out.println()`.

quiz.question: Java-la `() => {}`-a enna nu solluveenga?
quiz.why: Arrow functions dhaan TypeScript-oda lambdas.

deep.title: Flexible parameters

deep.text: Java-la objects-a anuppuveenga. TypeScript-la oru function-a innoru function-ukkum anuppalaam. `test('name', async () => {...})` appadi dhaan work aagudhu: rendavadhu argument oru function; adhai Playwright apparam odum.

deep.title: Functions-a pass pannuradhu
Tests-la helper function

deep.text: Page Objects-ukku pogaradhukku munnaadi, thirumba thirumba ezhudhuradhai thavirkka helper functions simple-aana vazhi.
`function` vs arrow: arrow functions-ukku thani `this` kidaiyaadhu. Tests-la idhu rombavum mukkiyam illa; aana classes-kulla gnabagam vachchukkonga.

challenge.prompt: 'Search' box-a fill pannitu, `press` true-a irundhaa mattum Enter press panra async helper `fillSearch(page, text, press = true)` ezhudhunga.

moreQuiz.question: `wait(ms: number = 1000)` na enna?
moreQuiz.why: Call pannuravar argument tharalana default value use aagum.

moreQuiz.question: `test('x', async () => {...})` yen work aagudhu?
moreQuiz.why: Unga function-a Playwright vaangi, thevai padumbodhu odum.

lessons.title: Arrays and objects
lessons.story: Array na toys oru line-la irukkura shelf. Object na `name`, `age`, `role` nu label ottina pockets irukkura backpack. Playwright oru backpack-a kuduthutu "unakku venum-nu pocket mattum edu" nu solludhu. Adhukku peyar destructuring.
lessons.codeCaption: Data vaikka class venaam. Simple object podhum.
points: Objects: `{ key: value }`. Dot vachu access pannalaam: `user.name`.
Arrays: `[a, b, c]`. Loop: `for (const x of list)`.
`async ({ page }) => ...` destructuring: Playwright tharra periya object-la irundhu `page`-a mattum edukkuradhu.

quiz.question: `async ({ page }) => {}`-la curly braces enna pannudhu?
quiz.why: Adhu dhaan destructuring: Playwright helpers niraindha object tharum; neenga venumnadhai edukkureenga.

deep.text: Interfaces: oru object-oda shape-a describe pannu
`interface` oru contract: 'indha type object-ukku indha fields irukkum'. Getters, setters illaadha Java POJO maadhiri.

deep.title: interface
map, filter, find
deep.code:
const nums = [1, 2, 3, 4];
nums.map((n) => n * 2);            // [2,4,6,8]
nums.filter((n) => n % 2 === 0);   // [2,4]
nums.find((n) => n > 2);           // 3
nums.some((n) => n > 3);           // true
nums.includes(3);                  // true
nums.length;                       // 4

deep.title: ... and ?.
deep.code:
const base = { headless: true, retries: 1 };
const custom = { ...base, retries: 3 };   // copy + override

const city = user.address?.city;          // undefined instead of crash
const name = user.nickname ?? 'friend';   // default if missing

deep.text: Config-la `...devices['Desktop Chrome']` paathirukkeenga. Adhu spread operator: settings-a unga object-kulla copy pannudhu.
Illaadha property-a padicha Java-oda NullPointerException maadhiri exception varaadhu; `undefined` kedaikkum. Bugs amaidhiya olinjirukkum; adhunaala unga objects-ukku type kudunga.

challenge.prompt: `const links = ['Home','Docs','API','Blog']` kudutha, 3 letters-ku mele irukkura peyargala mattum, uppercase-la, puthu array-a create pannunga.

moreQuiz.question: `{ ...base, retries: 3 }` enna pannudhu?
options: base-a copy panni retries-a override pannudhu
moreQuiz.why: Spread fields-a copy pannum; pinnaadi varra keys munnadi irukkuradhai override pannum.

moreQuiz.question: address undefined-aa irukkumbodhu `user.address?.city` tharuvadhu...
moreQuiz.why: Optional chaining safe-a nindrudum.

lessons.title: async and await (romba mukkiyam)
lessons.story: Neenga oru pizza order panreenga. Shop "vandhutte irukku" nu solludhu (adhu dhaan `Promise`). Varradhukku munnadi saapida aarambichaa, kaatha dhaan saapiduveenga. `await` na: pizza varra varaikkum inga wait pannu, appuram continue pannu. Playwright-oda ovvoru action-um oru pizza order, so ovvonnukkum `await` venum.
lessons.codeCaption: `await` `async` nu mark panna function-kulla mattum work aagum.
points: Browser actions-ku time aagum, so avai `Promise` ("appuram mudiyum" ticket) tharum.
`await` andha ticket mudiyara varaikkum test-a nirutthi vaikkum.
`await` marakkardhu dhaan beginners-oda number one bug. Adhai pidikka ESLint rule `no-floating-promises` on pannunga.
`async` function-ku munnadi; `await` action-ku munnadi.

quiz.question: `click()`-ku munnadi `await` marandha enna aagalaam?
options: Click mudiyarathukku munnadi next step odidum
quiz.why: await illaama code wait pannaadhu; steps onnoda onnu kalandhu test flaky aagum.

deep.text: Promise nu sonna innum ready aagaadha oru result-a represent panra object. Adhu pending, fulfilled (success) illa rejected (error)-nu irukkum. `await` adhai thirandhu tharum.

deep.title: Promise states

deep.text: Sequential awaits onnu pinnaadi onnaa odum. `Promise.all` ellaathaiyum serthu odi, ellaam mudiyura varaikkum wait pannum. 'Click pannitu puthu tab-ukku wait pannu' maadhiri patterns-ukku idhai use pannuveenga.

deep.title: Promise.all
try / catch / finally
Common mistakes

deep.text: `forEach`-kulla `await` irundha adhu wait pannaadhu. Steps order-la nadakkanum-na eppavum `for...of` loop use pannunga.

challenge.prompt: `page.getByRole('button')`-la irukkura ovvoru button-aiyum onnonna, order-la click panra loop ezhudhunga. (Hint: `.all()` and `for...of` venum.)

moreQuiz.question: Promise.all enna pannum?
options: Promises-a serthu odi ellaathukkum wait pannum
moreQuiz.why: Ovvoru promise-um mudiyura varaikkum adhu wait pannum.

moreQuiz.question: `forEach(async ...)` yen aabathu?
moreQuiz.why: forEach return aagura promises-a ignore pannum, adhunaala steps overlap aagum. for...of use pannunga.

lessons.title: Classes, import and export
lessons.story: Friend-oda room-la irundhu oru toy-a borrow panra maadhiri: neenga `import` pannureenga. Unga toy-a mathavanga edukkanum-na `export` pannureenga. Classes Java maadhiri dhaan, aana ceremony kammi. Aprom Page Objects-ku idhai use pannuveenga.
lessons.codeCaption: `constructor(private page: Page) {}` oru line-la field-a declare panni value-um kudukkudhu.
points: `export` na oru file-oda vishayathukku `public` maadhiri.
`import { X } from './file'` Java-oda `import package.X;`-ku badhil. Relative paths use pannunga.
Class-kulla fields-a access panna `this.` use pannunga.
Browser velai pannura methods `async`-a irukkum.

quiz.question: Unga class-a vera file use panna edhu allow pannum?
quiz.why: Adhai `export` nu mark pannunga; appuram vera idathula `import` pannunga.

deep.title: public / private / readonly
extends
Rendu vagai

deep.text: Oru file-ukku oru class; file name class name-a irukkanum. Java-la neenga follow pannura adhey tidy habits.
Import paths relative. `'./LoginPage'` na adhey folder; `'../pages/LoginPage'` na mudhalla mela po. `.ts` extension add pannaadheenga.

challenge.prompt: `protected page` and `goto(path)` method irukkura `BasePage` create pannunga. Appuram `BasePage`-a extend panra `DashboardPage`-la page-oda level-1 heading locator-a tharra `heading()` method ezhudhunga.

moreQuiz.question: `protected` edhai allow pannudhu?
moreQuiz.why: Java-oda protected maadhiri dhaan (package access thavira).

moreQuiz.question: Import paths-la `.ts` ezhudhanuma?
moreQuiz.why: Extension-a vittudunga.

lessons.title: Types, interfaces and generics
lessons.story: Types na square toy-a round hole-la podaama thadukkura name-tags. Unga tests odradhukku munnadiye TypeScript tags-a check pannum; so `.clik()` nu type panna thappu 10 minute run-ku appuram illa, ezhudhumbodhe pidipadum.
lessons.code:
type Status = 'pass' | 'fail';              // type alias with fixed choices
enum Env { Dev = 'dev', Prod = 'prod' }     // enum (strings are friendlier)

const names: Array<string> = [];             // same as string[]

function first<T>(list: T[]): T {            // generic, like Java's <T>
  return list[0];
